title: Design, characterization, and in vitro evaluation of magnetic carboxymethylated β-cyclodextrin as a pH-sensitive carrier system for amantadine delivery: a novel approach for targeted drug delivery
content:
RSC Adv., 2025, 15,446-459
DOI: 10.1039/D4RA06269H, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution 3.0 Unported Licence.
Mehrdad Hadadian, Reza Allahyari, Behnam Mahdavi, Esmail Rezaei-Seresht
In this study, a magnetic carboxymethylated β-cyclodextrin (Mag/CM-β-CD) was developed as a carrier system to assess its capability on drug delivery application by forming an inclusion complex with amantadine (Amn) as a drug model.
